hook: Starting August 14, 2026, Claude Code auto mode becomes the default for new sessions on Pro, Max, and Team plans. name: MCP 2026-07-28 — Stateless Core, Serverless-Ready; Biggest Spec Change Since Launch
hook: The fifth Model Context Protocol spec release removes the initialize handshake and Mcp-Session-Id header — every request now carries its own protocol version and capabilities, enabling MCP servers to deploy on serverless and edge infrastructure for the first time. Also ships: Multi Round-Trip Requests, header-based routing, cacheable list results, authorization hardening, and a versioned extensions framework for MCP Apps and Tasks (interactive UIs, long-running work). Support rolling out across Claude products. DevelopersDigest published a full migration breakdown; HN item 49088058 has 300+ comments.

name: Claude Security — Anthropic's Multi-Agent Vulnerability Scanner, Now Open to All Paid Users

Scans before commit, full repository, or PR diff. Requires Claude Code v2.1.154+, Python 3.9.6+, and dynamic workflows enabled in /config. Enterprise plans additionally get automated third-party skill/plugin scanning to catch malicious content at upload.
